newsitem.title: UK: Clarke says international confidence boosting stg.
newsitem.headline: Clarke says international confidence boosting stg.

text.p: International confidence about Britain's economic prospects is boosting sterling, Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Thursday.

He told parliament that Britain, for the first time, had retained the competitive advantages of a devaluation because the government had taken the tough measures that were necessary in order to do so.

"Now the pound is strengthening, strengthening strongly," Clarke said at question time. "...It's just going back to where it was about 18 months to two years ago, and that is because of confidence in international markets about the long-term stability and prosperity of the economny of this country."
